notes: DC battery-backup wall-mount Wi-Fi opener. The light is a separate myQ remote LED light supplied in the carton.

gaps: There is no repair-parts list here.
No FCC ID tied to this model was found.
method: Main source: LiftMaster's own product sheet LMGDENPG8500W (dated 10/19, copyright 2019); its text layer is scrambled, so page 2 was also read as a rendered image.
The owner's manual listed on Chamberlain Group's support site opens in a Widen document viewer that couldn't be read as text.
The sheet rates the whole opener at 120 V AC, 60 Hz, 1.5 A current rating; that is kept here rather than on any part.
The sheet gives the light as 827LM, called Wi-Fi on page 1.
The sheet's myQ radio is 902-928 MHz, 50-channel FHSS, for 2-way communication between the opener and myQ accessories.
The logic board number is the one the sheet gives for replacement logic boards.

The battery entry comes from a garage-door parts retailer page that lists the 8500W among the openers using the 485LM and gives 41A6357-1 as another number for it; the product sheet confirms the 485LM is included.

comps.spec: Heavy-duty 12 V DC motor with automatic thermal protection, permanently lubricated
Internal chain and sprocket drive, 63:1 gear reduction
DC Wi-Fi logic board with built-in surge suppressor (replacement logic boards: part 050DCRJWF); the opener is listed as frequency-agile on 310, 315 and 390 MHz under Security+ 2.0 radio controls
myQ remote LED light 827LM, a separate unit included in the carton: 1,500 lm, mounts to ceiling or wall, hinged cover
The Protector System safety reversing sensors, included
Backup battery LiftMaster 485LM (also sold as 485LMC, Chamberlain 4228, 41A6357-1): 12 V DC sealed rechargeable lead battery
6 ft 3-prong power cord for the opener's AC supply

sources.title: LiftMaster 8500W DC Battery Backup Wall Mount Wi-Fi Garage Door Opener product sheet LMGDENPG8500W (10/19, manufacturer PDF)
